latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add synchronized lyrics overlays to videos with automated cloud processing.

- Upload videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and sync song lyrics as on-screen text.
- Cloud GPU backend processes lyrics sync and video export in about 1–2 minutes.
- Supports easy session management, credit tracking, and export/download workflows.
- Includes error handling and tips for best results.
- Output videos provided in 1080p MP4 format.
